# netactuate_vpc_backend_template_backends (Resource)

Manages a VPC Backend Template Backends.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_vpc_backend_template_backends" "example" {
  backend_template_id = 12345
  vpc_id              = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backend_template_id` (Number) Backend template ID whose backends are managed.
- `vpc_id` (Number) VPC ID that owns the backend template.

### Optional

- `backend_host` (Block List) Complete replacement set of backend hosts for the template. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--backend_host))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--backend_host"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backend_host`

Required:

- `address` (String) Backend host address.
- `name` (String) Backend host name.

Read-Only:

- `backend_host_id` (Number) Backend host ID assigned by the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_vpc_backend_template_backends.example 12345
```
